ListingDisplayState.description: The product on this store, in one state computed by the server: `draft` (not selected for the store), `needs_details` (selected, but the store setup or the product lacks something publishing needs), `ready` (publishable, not sent yet), `publishing` (queued or in flight, including an update of a published listing that a sync or retry queued), `published`, `failed`, `removing` (being taken off) or `removed`.

PublishRequirement.description: For `needs_details`: the requirement to fix first, so a client can open the right place. Store-setup requirements (`reconnect`, `account_settings`, `shipping_policy`, `payment_policy`, `return_policy`, `ship_from_location`, `listing_setup`) come before the product’s (`images`, `active_product`, `option_names`), which the server checks before publishing; `category` and `item_specifics` are known once the channel refused a publish. Null for the other states.

displayState.description: The product on this store, in one state computed by the server: `draft` (not selected for the store), `needs_details` (selected, but the store setup or the product lacks something publishing needs), `ready` (publishable, not sent yet), `publishing` (queued or in flight, including an update of a published listing that a sync or retry queued), `published`, `failed`, `removing` (being taken off) or `removed`.

displayReason.example: Choose a shipping policy in this eBay connection’s listing defaults.
displayReason.description: For `needs_details` and `failed`: a short, merchant-readable reason (what to add, or the channel’s message). Never holds secrets. Null for the other states.

displayRequirement.description: For `needs_details`: the requirement to fix first, so a client can open the right place. Store-setup requirements (`reconnect`, `account_settings`, `shipping_policy`, `payment_policy`, `return_policy`, `ship_from_location`, `listing_setup`) come before the product’s (`images`, `active_product`, `option_names`), which the server checks before publishing; `category` and `item_specifics` are known once the channel refused a publish. Null for the other states.
